scope.summary: Implement Marvelous-compatible Pattern Archive semantics: active/archived panel state, dotted 2D retained outline, exclusion from 3D and simulation, restore, dependencies, undo/replay, API, and exact native UI behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Archived panels retain stable ids, geometry, seams, materials, notes, provenance, and dotted 2D projection while being excluded from tessellation, 3D scene, simulation, selection defaults, and export unless explicitly requested.

Reusable Pattern Archive entries preserve pattern geometry, internal lines, sewing, grading, seam allowances, annotations, notches, avatar/profile requirements, fabric suggestions, preview artifacts, semantic tags, provenance, version/supersession, and dependency compatibility under 13.31 [TAI-CLP-005].

Search, preview, insert, replace, and combine use canonical backend actions and create inspectable proposals with compatibility/conflict diagnostics; only explicit selected apply mutates the project, and source archive entries are never overwritten silently.
Archive/unarchive previews dependency effects, is atomic/undoable/replayable/idempotent, handles concurrent edits and stale versions, and never aliases project archive or snapshot restore.

Backend and Argus tests prove entry search/preview/insert/replace/combine, active/archive/restore, selection/filtering, dependency and seam diagnostics, restart, proposal rejection/rollback, and no hidden simulation participation.
scope.risk_if_missed: Project snapshots cannot substitute for Pattern Archive and would delete or simulate panels with the wrong semantics.

surfaces: Tailor Pattern Archive in 2D pattern workspace

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Garment authoring > Pattern Archive, restore, and simulation exclusion

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Archive, restore, dependency-effect apply/revert, and undo/replay operations require authoritative events and receipts.
Pattern Archive directly exposes dependent-seam, selection, exclusion, stale-version, conflict, and restore diagnostics.
Pattern archive state changes own no long-running job, device, or child-process lifecycle.

risks: Project snapshots cannot substitute for Pattern Archive and would delete or simulate panels with the wrong semantics.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.
